visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a close-up of a young woman with short black hair and bangs, wearing a brown t-shirt. She is drinking through a straw from a plastic cup featuring the 7-Eleven logo. She makes an exaggeratedly surprised face with wide eyes and gives a thumbs-up. (2) A transition shows a first-person view of a hand reaching into a commercial freezer and grabbing a plastic cup filled with frozen fruit and white yogurt-like cubes. The background shows a retail shelf with various smoothie flavors. (3) The hand is seen scanning the cup's barcode at a white machine, then peeling back the plastic seal to reveal frozen strawberries and blueberries inside. (4) The cup is placed into the circular slot of a black automated blender. A digital touch screen displays a simple rabbit animation and progress icons. (5) The machine blends the drink, turning the contents into a thick, pinkish-purple liquid. The camera captures the rotation through the clear plastic cup. (6) The woman appears again, holding the finished smoothie cup up to the camera and nodding while taking a sip, smiling in a brightly lit indoor environment.
